mushroom.zh: 又是蘑菇呀……我会好好吃的。
mushroom.en: Mushrooms again... I will eat them, promise.

mushroom.zh: 这味道，好像刚刚才吃过呢。
mushroom.en: This tastes rather familiar, doesn’t it?

mushroom.zh: 第三回见面了，小蘑菇……
mushroom.en: Our third meeting, little mushroom...

mushroom.zh: 我的碗快要长出蘑菇了吧。
mushroom.en: I think my bowl is turning into a mushroom patch.

mushroom.zh: 下次……可以有一点甜的吗？
mushroom.en: Could there be something sweet next time...?

mushroom.zh: 蘑菇也很好，只是有一点想念水果。
mushroom.en: They are nice. I just miss fruit a little.

ordinary.en: Thank you for saving me a place.
This is a comforting little bite.
One little puff, and it is just right.

ordinary.zh: 坐在这里吃，味道也暖了。
ordinary.en: It tastes warmer with us all here.

favorite.zh: 是我喜欢的甜味……你记得呀。
favorite.en: My favourite sweetness... you remembered.
I want to make this little bite last.
I can’t hide my smile, can I?

favorite.zh: 水果的香气，像个小拥抱。
favorite.en: That fruity scent feels like a tiny hug.

favorite.zh: 好开心……还能再闻一下吗？
favorite.en: Oh, lovely... may I breathe it in once more?

favorite.zh: 今天的碗里，装着我的最爱。
favorite.en: My favourite thing, right here in my bowl.

mushroom.zh: 又是蘑菇！肚子说行，嘴巴说等等！
mushroom.en: Mushrooms again! Tummy says yes. Taste buds request a meeting!

mushroom.zh: 蘑菇怎么又抢到菜单第一名啦？
mushroom.en: How did mushrooms win the menu AGAIN?

mushroom.zh: 第三顿！我快变成小蘑菇啦！
mushroom.en: Round three! I’m growing a mushroom hat!

mushroom.zh: 下次烤鱼！我先替嘴巴报名！
mushroom.en: Fish next time! My mouth has volunteered!

mushroom.zh: 饱是饱啦，惊喜跑哪儿去啦？
mushroom.en: Full, yes! But where did the surprise go?

mushroom.zh: 蘑菇蘑菇……我会背菜单啦！
mushroom.en: Mushroom, mushroom... I know this menu by heart!

ordinary.zh: 开动开动！第一口归我啦！
ordinary.en: Dig in! First bite is mine!
Smells good! Look, I’m sitting properly!
Everything tastes fun round a fire!

favorite.en: FISH! Dinner wins today!
That bite is ridiculously good!

favorite.zh: 先别说话，让我开心地嚼完！
favorite.en: Hold that thought! I need to finish this happy bite!
My favourite! I could hug this plate!

favorite.zh: 嘿嘿，我连香气都舍不得放跑！
favorite.en: Hehe! Even the smell isn’t getting away!
Fish fish fish! This dinner goes in the book!

mushroom.zh: 又是蘑菇。行，先吃饱。
mushroom.en: Mushrooms again. Fine. Fuel first.

mushroom.zh: 这菜单，倒是很稳定。
mushroom.en: A very consistent menu.

mushroom.zh: 第三顿了。蘑菇出勤比我还稳。
mushroom.en: Third serving. These mushrooms have perfect attendance.

mushroom.zh: 下回换道菜吧，我认真建议。
mushroom.en: A different dish next time. A formal recommendation.

mushroom.zh: 肚子没意见，舌头有一点。
mushroom.en: Stomach approves. Tongue has a small objection.

mushroom.zh: 吃完了。蘑菇专项训练完成。
mushroom.en: Finished. Mushroom training complete.

ordinary.en: Sit properly. Eat while it’s warm.
Dinner first. Everything else can wait.
Good. Everybody has something to eat.

favorite.en: Now that is a proper meal.

favorite.zh: 这锅做得好，我认真夸你。
favorite.en: Excellent pot of food. That is genuine praise.
I like it. That isn’t politeness.

favorite.zh: 这一口，值得坐下来慢慢吃。
favorite.en: Worth sitting down and taking my time over.

favorite.zh: 锅里都是好东西，没白等。
favorite.en: A pot full of good things. Worth the wait.

favorite.zh: 今天不急着做事，先尝好这一碗。
favorite.en: Work can wait. This bowl deserves my attention.

mushroom.zh: ……又是蘑菇。
mushroom.en: ...Mushrooms again.

mushroom.zh: 嗯。熟悉得过头了。
mushroom.en: Mm. Too familiar.

mushroom.zh: ……第三回。蘑菇也该歇了。
mushroom.en: ...Third time. Even mushrooms need a day off.

mushroom.zh: 喜欢蘑菇。也不能一直是它。
mushroom.en: I like mushrooms. A little variety, though.

mushroom.zh: ……烤焦一点，假装换了菜。
mushroom.en: ...Char it a little. We can pretend it’s different.

mushroom.zh: 蘑菇。它大概也认得我了。
mushroom.en: Mushrooms. They probably recognise me by now.

ordinary.en: ...No need to talk. Still a good dinner.

favorite.en: ...This. I like this.
Mm. A bowl worth looking up for.
...Wait. Let the scent stay a little.

favorite.zh: 黑暗里，也有这么好的味道。
favorite.en: Even the dark has flavours like this.
I’ll remember this bite.
...My smile? Nothing. Just good food.
